recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the original URL separation in the current active Contract example source; no additional core source work is indicated for FHIR-17917 unless a later, separate Contract-removal decision is merged into this branch.
issue_request: FHIR-17917 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management change request asking to change the Contract code system URL from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/coverage-copay-type to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/contract-type so Contract type codes would not be exposed under the Coverage copay type system.
initial_application: Commit 182ce2688b7257156c2a879e4f64f362546cff84 initially applied the issue by updating source/contract/codesystem-contract-type.xml, source/contract/valueset-contract-type.xml, and source/contract/contract-example-ins-policy.xml. Commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 later removed the core Contract CodeSystem source during UTG migration after it already carried the corrected contract-type URL.
additional_context: Contract is active in source/fhir.ini and source/contract/list-Contract-examples.xml includes the general Contract example. The Contract type ValueSet and the insurance policy Contract example already use http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/contract-type, while Coverage still correctly uses http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/coverage-copay-type. The only remaining Contract-source use of the Coverage copay system was in a commented Contract.type snippet in source/contract/contract-example.xml, and the raw published XML example surfaces that comment.
reconciliation: Changed source/contract/contract-example.xml so the commented Contract.type coding system uses http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/contract-type. No Coverage source or unrelated Contract terminology was changed.
source_changes: source/contract/contract-example.xml: changed the commented Contract.type coding system from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/coverage-copay-type to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/contract-type.
